name: Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an employer's letter stating the type of employment and wages, an offer of employment for at least one year, and the employer accepting responsibility for the employee.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a confirmed job offer of at least 1 year from a Dominica-based employer.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires the employer to submit newspaper advertisements of the vacant position (a labour-market test showing the role could not be filled locally).

evidence_required.document: Employer's offer letter (type, wages, 1-year minimum term, responsibility acceptance)
Three copies of newspaper vacancy advertisements
Medical certificate, police record (home country), valid passport, photographs, return-travel proof

sources.title: Invest Dominica Authority (investdominica.com) -- Work & Residency Permit -- statutory Government of Dominica investment-promotion body

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Dominica's initial build. Source treated as tier-1: Invest Dominica Authority is the Government of Dominica's statutory investment-promotion agency, not a .gov.dm domain but an official government body, consistent with how this dataset has treated equivalent statutory-authority sources for other countries. A work permit of 6+ months' term automatically confers residency status per this source -- captured via leads_to_pr/pr_after_months feeding dm_permanent_residence's 5-year test, not as a separate field. family_can_join set false as a conservative default: the source does not describe a dependant-sponsorship right attached to this permit itself. Fee: EC$800/US$295 (non-CARICOM), EC$250/US$93 (CARICOM).
